payload.name: Discipline Rewards (D/R)
payload.description: 随处规划，在 D/R 中执行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Want to build better habits, stay consistent with goals, improve your health, strengthen your routines, or create a plan for personal growth? ChatGPT can help you brainstorm ideas, structure goals, build habit systems, and create accountability plans tailored to what you're trying to achieve.

When you're ready, ChatGPT can send that plan to Discipline Rewards as a pending draft for review. Nothing is added automatically. Every plan must be reviewed and approved inside Discipline Rewards before habits, goals, or accountability commitments are created.

Discipline Rewards helps turn good intentions into consistent action. Use ChatGPT to think through the plan, then use Discipline Rewards to review, approve, and execute it.

This integration is designed to keep planning flexible while keeping execution intentional. Build plans in ChatGPT, then follow through in Discipline Rewards.
payload.longDescription:
想养成更好的习惯、坚持目标、改善健康、加强日常规律，或制定个人成长计划？ChatGPT 可以帮你构思想法、梳理目标、建立习惯体系，并根据你的目标制定问责计划。

准备好后，ChatGPT 可以将计划发送到 Discipline Rewards，作为待审核草稿。内容不会自动添加。必须在 Discipline Rewards 中审查并批准每项计划，之后才会创建习惯、目标或问责承诺。

Discipline Rewards 帮助你将良好意愿转化为持续行动。先用 ChatGPT 梳理计划，再用 Discipline Rewards 审核、批准并执行。

此集成旨在让规划保持灵活，同时确保执行经过慎重确认。在 ChatGPT 中制定计划，再通过 Discipline Rewards 跟进落实。

payload.name: TrackTogether
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TrackTogether helps people create trackers, manage checklist tasks, collaborate with friends, and follow progress through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: TrackTogether 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 创建追踪器、管理清单任务、与朋友协作并跟进进度。

payload.name: wiserwork
payload.description: 将会议转化为可交付成果
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: wiserwork is an AI meeting platform for teams that turns meetings into searchable knowledge and finished work. In ChatGPT, users can review their synchronized meeting schedule, retrieve transcripts and summaries, and find decisions and action items.
payload.longDescription: wiserwork 是面向团队的 AI 会议平台，可将会议转化为可搜索的知识和完成的工作。在 ChatGPT 中，用户可以查看已同步的会议日程、检索转录文本和摘要，并查找决策和行动事项。

payload.name: ArtifactBridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ArtifactBridge connects ChatGPT to your team's document workspace. Search and read stored documents, create managed documents, discuss changes, and submit proposals for review. Governed document changes require an authorized human review; owners can update working documents directly when review is not required. You can also organize documents, coordinate work in Agent Rooms, and publish a version through a share link. Depending on your workspace configuration, comments may be mirrored to Google Docs or Notion, proposals may notify Slack, and activity events may be delivered to external webhooks. Access and review permissions still apply. Requires an ArtifactBridge account.
payload.longDescription: ArtifactBridge 将 ChatGPT 连接到团队的文档工作区。搜索和阅读已存储文档，创建受管理的文档，讨论修改，并提交提案供审阅。受管控的文档修改需要授权人员审批；不需要审阅时，所有者可直接更新工作文档。你还可以整理文档、在 Agent Rooms 中协调工作，并通过分享链接发布某个版本。根据工作区配置，评论可能同步到 Google Docs 或 Notion，提案可能触发 Slack 通知，活动事件可能传送到外部 webhook。访问和审阅权限仍然适用。需要 ArtifactBridge 账号。

payload.name: JobIQ Jobsuche
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: JobIQ Job Search finds open roles on the Swiss JobIQ job board. Search by keyword, occupation group, location, and workload, see title, employer, and a short summary, then open the original listing on JobIQ.
payload.longDescription: JobIQ 求职搜索可在瑞士 JobIQ 招聘网站中查找开放职位。按关键词、职业类别、地点和工作量搜索，查看职位名称、雇主和简短摘要，然后打开 JobIQ 上的原始职位信息。

payload.name: AB Projects
payload.description: 为 MS Teams 提供 AI 操作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AB (ActionBridge) provides a secure and reliable integration layer between your AI agents and Microsoft Teams. It enables your models to interact directly with your workspace, transforming passive AI insights into active participants in your team's daily operations.

Key Features
Direct Teams Connectivity: Seamlessly link your AI models to Microsoft Teams channels and private chats.

Workflow Automation: Trigger real-time messages, notifications, and status updates based on agent-driven logic.

Secure Integration: Designed as a professional conduit to ensure stable data flow between LLMs and enterprise communication hubs.

Why You’ll Love It
AB eliminates the need to manually relay information between your AI tools and your team. By allowing your agent to communicate where the work happens, it reduces context switching and ensures that AI-generated actions are delivered instantly to the right stakeholders. Whether you are automating project updates or facilitating AI-driven collaboration, AB makes your agents more actionable and effective.
payload.longDescription:
AB（ActionBridge）在你的 AI 智能体和 Microsoft Teams 之间提供安全可靠的集成层。它让模型可以直接与你的工作区交互，将被动的 AI 洞察转化为团队日常运营中的主动参与者。

主要功能
直接连接 Teams：将你的 AI 模型无缝连接到 Microsoft Teams 频道和私人聊天。

工作流自动化：根据智能体驱动的逻辑触发实时消息、通知和状态更新。

安全集成：作为专业连接通道，确保 LLM 与企业沟通中心之间的数据稳定流动。

你会喜欢它的原因
AB 让你无需在 AI 工具和团队之间手动传递信息。让智能体在实际开展工作的地方沟通，可以减少上下文切换，并确保 AI 生成的操作即时传达给适当的相关人员。无论是自动发送项目更新，还是促进 AI 驱动的协作，AB 都能让你的智能体更有执行力、更有效。

payload.name: Ingest Labs
payload.description: 在聊天中分析营销数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ingest Labs connects ChatGPT to your production Ingest Labs account over MCP so you can query marketing analytics and inspect Tag Manager configuration.
Sign in with the same portal account used on console.ingestlabs.com.
After choosing an organization, use Insights tools for Attribution, Ad spend and ROAS, user events, Traffic Quality insights, and Tag Manager tools to list or change providers, tags, and data elements.
payload.longDescription: Ingest Labs 通过 MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到生产环境 Ingest Labs 账户，以查询营销分析并检查标签管理器配置。使用 console.ingestlabs.com 的同一门户账户登录。选择组织后，可使用 Insights 工具查看归因、广告支出和 ROAS、用户事件、流量质量，以及列出或修改提供商、标签和数据元素。

payload.name: Contextli
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Contextli turns your voice notes and transcriptions into a searchable second brain. Connect it to pull up your own notes and contexts, and search across everything you have captured, without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: Contextli 可将语音笔记和转写内容转化为可搜索的第二大脑。连接后即可调取自己的笔记和上下文，并在聊天中搜索所有已记录的内容。

payload.name: Simply-Useful
payload.summaryOriginal: Manage your tasks and your day
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access and manage your Simply-Useful account from ChatGPT. Organize your day in plain language: review your agenda and priorities, catch up on overdue work, and see what others have assigned to you — all in one ask. Create and schedule tasks as you think of them, group them into projects, add checklists and tags, and send appointments straight to your Google Calendar. You can also hand tasks to your contacts and follow up with comments; anything that affects another person asks for your confirmation first. Every change syncs instantly with the Simply-Useful mobile and web apps.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中访问和管理你的 Simply-Useful 账户。用日常语言安排一天：一并查看日程和优先事项、跟进逾期工作，以及查看他人分配给你的任务。想到任务时即可创建并安排时间，将任务归入项目、添加核对清单和标签，还可直接将约会发送到 Google Calendar。你也可以把任务交给联系人并通过评论跟进；任何会影响他人的操作都会先征求你的确认。每次更改都会立即同步到 Simply-Useful 移动应用和网页版应用。

payload.name: mfloow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
mfloow is a business process improvement platform that uses AI to provide end-to-end support, from visualizing operations to ensuring that improvements are successfully embedded across the organization.

By visualizing task progress, assignees, deadlines, and approval statuses, mfloow enables users to quickly understand the overall state of their operations. It also standardizes business workflows to reduce inconsistencies between individuals and prevent processes from becoming dependent on specific employees. In addition, mfloow automates routine activities such as initiating workflows, assigning tasks, and sending notifications, thereby reducing administrative effort and human error. Its AI-assisted workflow creation capabilities help organizations reduce the time required to design processes, improve operational quality, and establish a sustainable framework for continuous improvement.

The mfloow plugin allows users to access flow and task information stored in mfloow and check progress, deadlines, and assigned work through a conversational interface. Users can review ongoing flows, identify their assigned tasks, and detect overdue tasks, as well as view detailed information such as task comments, checklists, related tasks, and approval statuses.
payload.longDescription:
mfloow 是一个业务流程改进平台，使用 AI 提供端到端支持，从可视化运营到确保改进在整个组织中成功落地。

通过可视化任务进度、负责人、截止日期和审批状态，mfloow 让用户快速了解运营整体状态。它还会标准化业务工作流，减少个人之间的不一致，防止流程依赖特定员工。此外，mfloow 会自动执行启动工作流、分配任务和发送通知等日常活动，从而减少行政工作和人为错误。其 AI 辅助的工作流创建能力帮助组织缩短设计流程所需的时间、提高运营质量，并建立可持续的持续改进框架。

mfloow 插件允许用户访问存储在 mfloow 中的流程和任务信息，并通过对话界面检查进度、截止日期和分配的工作。用户可以查看进行中的流程、找出分配给自己的任务、发现逾期任务，还可以查看任务评论、检查清单、相关任务和审批状态等详细信息。

payload.name: GPS-Ortung24
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GPS-Ortung24 connects your AI assistant to your vehicle fleet. Ask in plain language where a vehicle is, which vehicles are moving or parked, how far they drove, whether there were any alerts, or generate a GoBD-compliant logbook for last month — and get an instant answer including plain-text addresses. Access is strictly read-only and multi-tenant: each customer signs in with their own GPS-Ortung24 account via OAuth and sees only their own vehicles. Drivers are pseudonymized; billing data is never exposed.
payload.longDescription: GPS-Ortung24 将 AI 助手连接到你的车辆车队。用日常语言询问车辆位置、哪些车辆正在行驶或停放、行驶了多远、是否有警报，或生成上个月符合 GoBD 规范的行车日志——系统会立即作答，其中包括纯文本地址。访问严格为只读且采用多租户模式：每位客户都通过 OAuth 使用自己的 GPS-Ortung24 账户登录，并且只能查看自有车辆。驾驶员身份经过假名化处理；计费数据绝不会公开。

payload.name: NextClip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NextClip helps you turn any YouTube video into short-form clips. Paste a link, choose your settings — clip length, aspect ratio, frame layout, and moment focus — and the AI finds the best moments and adds captions and hook text automatically. You get clips with title, description, and virality scores. You can export to MP4 and publish or schedule clips directly to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and Facebook from within the conversation.
payload.longDescription: NextClip 帮你把任意 YouTube 视频剪辑成短视频。粘贴链接，选择设置——片段时长、画面比例、布局和重点内容——AI 就会自动找出精彩片段并添加字幕和吸引眼球的文案。你会获得带标题、说明和传播力评分的片段。可以导出为 MP4，并直接在对话中发布或安排发布到 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube Shorts、LinkedIn 和 Facebook。

payload.name: FunkyTime
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FunkyTime helps users inspect projects and clients, track working time and running timers, manage related expenses, and review time and billing summaries through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: FunkyTime 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看项目和客户、追踪工时和正在运行的计时器、管理相关开销，并查看工时与计费汇总。

payload.name: VesselTwin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect VesselTwin to ask ChatGPT about the boat records you already keep. New to VesselTwin? Visit vesseltwin.io to create a free account, then select Connect and sign in. Basic access shows approved boat, maintenance, equipment, and document metadata. Owner Pro customers can separately opt in to let ChatGPT read private records, including extracted document text, for boats they own. An optional second permission lets ChatGPT send proposed notes, checklists, maintenance entries, and measurements to the VesselTwin Inbox for owner review. Nothing becomes a saved record until the owner accepts it, and customers can turn either permission off at any time. Photo files and private records from collaborator-only boats are never included.
payload.longDescription: 连接 VesselTwin，即可让 ChatGPT 查询你已保存的船只记录。刚开始使用 VesselTwin？访问 vesseltwin.io 创建免费账户，然后选择“连接”并登录。基础访问权限可查看已批准的船只、维护、设备和文档元数据。Owner Pro 客户可以另行选择允许 ChatGPT 读取其所拥有船只的私人记录，包括提取出的文档文本。另一个可选的权限允许 ChatGPT 将建议的备注、检查清单、维护记录和测量数据发送到 VesselTwin 收件箱，供船主审核。只有船主接受后，内容才会保存为记录；客户可随时关闭任一权限。绝不会包含照片文件，也不会包含仅与协作者共享的船只的私人记录。

payload.name: Sive.Host Domain Finder
payload.description: 查找域名和主机托管服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sive.Host Domain Finder helps you check whether a domain is available, compare domain prices, discover alternative names, and view hosting plans. It keeps the search simple and shows clear next steps when you are ready to continue on Sive.Host.
payload.longDescription: Sive.Host Domain Finder 可帮助你检查域名是否可用、比较域名价格、发现替代名称并查看主机托管方案。当你准备继续操作时，它会让搜索流程保持简洁，并清楚显示后续步骤。

payload.name: Lifespace Communities
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lifespace Communities helps job seekers explore open roles at Lifespace Communities. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. 
Powered by Appcast.
payload.longDescription:
Lifespace Communities 帮助求职者探索 Lifespace Communities 的空缺职位。按职位名称、地点或两者搜索，助手会为你筛选相关机会，并让你在申请前深入查看详情。
由 Appcast 提供支持。

payload.name: Domus - Homeowners Ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Domus is a home hub that remembers what you forget. Ask about your home and let ChatGPT act on it: look up what filter your furnace takes, check which appliance warranties are about to lapse, log a repair you just did, add a new appliance with its model, serial, and warranty, or open a document like an inspection report and review it. Domus keeps a living record of every property you own — appliances, documents, maintenance schedules, and air filters — synced across web, iOS, and Android. This plugin can both read and update your Domus home. Free to start; your data stays exportable and deletable, and you can revoke access anytime.
payload.longDescription: Domus 是一个不会忘事的家庭中枢。询问有关家中的问题并让 ChatGPT 帮你处理：查找暖炉使用哪种滤芯，检查哪些家电保修即将到期，记录刚完成的维修，为新家电添加型号、序列号和保修信息，或打开验房报告等文件进行查看。Domus 会持续记录你拥有的每处房产信息——包括家电、文档、维护计划和空气滤网——并在网页版、iOS 和 Android 之间同步。此插件可以读取并更新你的 Domus 家庭信息。可免费开始使用；数据可以导出和删除，你也可以随时撤销访问权限。

payload.name: TracX Logis
payload.description: 追踪货件并预订全球运输
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Effortless Global Shipping and Tracking with TX Logis

TX Logis is a global logistics and parcel delivery assistant that helps users navigate international shipping services with ease.

Whether you are sending personal parcels overseas, booking a pickup, submitting a shipping request, or tracking a business shipment, TX Logis provides step-by-step guidance for smooth and reliable delivery support.

TX Logis supports users looking for logistics services, parcel delivery, courier service, shipping reservations, shipment requests, personal shipping, quick delivery, international shipping, and shipment tracking.

Key Features:

- Real-time Tracking: Learn how to check your shipment status instantly using your tracking number or waybill.
- SmartPost Booking: Guidance for C2C international parcel delivery, personal shipping, pickup booking, and door-to-door services.
- Shipping Reservation and Request Support: Help with delivery reservations, shipment requests, parcel booking, and international shipping applications.
- Global Shipping Guide: Instructions for shipping to 70+ countries including Japan, Singapore, the US, and other major destinations.
- Logistics and Courier Support: Quick answers about logistics services, parcel delivery, courier service, quick delivery, shipping rates, prohibited items, and required documentation.
- Personal and Business Shipping: Support for both individual customers and business users sending parcels or managing shipments.

Simplify your international logistics, parcel delivery, booking, and tracking experience with the TX Logis assistant.
payload.longDescription:
通过 TX Logis 轻松完成全球运输与追踪

TX Logis 是一款全球物流和包裹配送助手，帮助用户轻松使用国际运输服务。

无论你是要寄送个人包裹到海外、预约取件、提交运输申请，还是追踪企业货件，TX Logis 都会分步骤提供顺畅可靠的配送支持。

TX Logis 支持需要物流服务、包裹配送、快递服务、运输预订、货件申请、个人寄件、快速配送、国际运输和货件追踪的用户。

主要功能：

- 实时追踪：了解如何使用追踪号码或运单即时查询货件状态。
- SmartPost 预订：提供 C2C 国际包裹配送、个人寄件、预约取件和门到门服务指南。
- 运输预订和申请支持：协助办理配送预订、货件申请、包裹寄送和国际运输申请。
- 全球运输指南：提供寄往 70+ 个国家/地区的说明，包括日本、新加坡、美国及其他主要目的地。
- 物流和快递支持：快速解答物流服务、包裹配送、快递、快速配送、运费、禁运物品和所需文件等问题。
- 个人与企业寄件：为个人客户及寄送包裹或管理货件的企业用户提供支持。

使用 TX Logis 助手，简化国际物流、包裹配送、预订和追踪体验。

payload.name: Figr
payload.description: 面向产品团队的设计助手
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Figr is an AI design tool for product teams. It creates UI, stores your design system, and tracks the reasoning behind your product decisions. This MCP lets ChatGPT read your Figr projects. Open any design, extract artifact code, search your UX library, and use your product context in any conversation.
payload.longDescription: Figr 是一款面向产品团队的 AI 设计工具，可创建界面、存储设计系统并记录产品决策背后的理由。此 MCP 可让 ChatGPT 读取你的 Figr 项目。打开任意设计、提取成果代码、搜索 UX 资源库，并在任何对话中运用产品上下文。

payload.name: PandaDoc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create any agreement in ChatGPT and send it for e-signature without leaving the conversation. Describe what you need, watch it take shape, add your recipients, and send. Your AI draft becomes a polished, signature-ready agreement automatically.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开对话，即可在 ChatGPT 中创建各类协议并发送电子签名。描述你的需求，查看协议逐步成形，添加收件人并发送。你的 AI 草稿会自动变成精致且可供签署的协议。

payload.name: NexoRush
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover freelance professionals based on the skills and expertise your project needs. NexoRush helps you find relevant public profiles, explore professional skills, and identify the right expertise for your project.
payload.longDescription: 根据项目所需技能和专长，发现自由职业专业人士。NexoRush 帮助你查找相关的公开个人资料、了解专业技能，并为项目找到合适的专才。

payload.name: Dayalogs
payload.description: AI 问卷实地调研管理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dayalogs gives teams survey authoring tools, distribution workflows and full fieldwork control from their own AI. It helps create, validate, preview, and manage schema-first online surveys, with support for survey definitions, translations, respondent links, LinkSets, embeds, campaigns, audiences, review rounds, branding, styles, responses and exports through a scoped OAuth MCP connection.
payload.longDescription: Dayalogs 为团队提供问卷编写工具、分发工作流和完整的实地调研管理能力，可通过自己的 AI 使用。它帮助创建、验证、预览和管理以架构定义为先的在线问卷，并通过限定范围的 OAuth MCP 连接支持问卷定义、翻译、受访者链接、LinkSets、嵌入代码、营销活动、受众、审核轮次、品牌、样式、回复和导出。

payload.name: Ellie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ellie helps users review, search, create, update, complete, and delete tasks in their private Ellie Planner account, and organize those tasks with lists and labels.
payload.longDescription: Ellie 可帮助用户在个人 Ellie Planner 账户中查看、搜索、创建、更新、完成和删除任务，并使用列表和标签整理任务。

payload.name: Instrumentl
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Instrumentl integration for nonprofits. Make Instrumentl a native part of your AI workflow – an intelligent partner that helps you find, win, and manage grants faster, directly in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 面向非营利组织的 Instrumentl 集成。让 Instrumentl 成为 AI 工作流中的原生一环——它是智能伙伴，可直接在 ChatGPT 中帮助你更快地发现、赢得并管理资助。

payload.name: KaoJai.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A chatbot companion who truly understand you and your business.
- Ask information related to KaoJai.ai Platform
- Help business manage setting and configuration in admin.kaojai.ai platform via chat interface
- Find availability of the business who register in KaoJai platform
payload.longDescription:
一个真正理解你和你的业务的聊天机器人伙伴。
- 询问与 KaoJai.ai 平台相关的信息
- 通过聊天界面帮助企业管理 admin.kaojai.ai 平台中的设置和配置
- 查找在 KaoJai 平台注册的企业是否有空档

payload.name: AutoRFP.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AutoRFP.ai is an accuracy-first AI platform for RFPs, security questionnaires, and DDQs. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your live RFP, DDQ or security questionnaire projects and source-grounded content library.

Ask what's outstanding across your current RFP projects, list the questions still waiting on answers, and search for accurate answers in your content library without leaving the conversation.

Draft with content your team has already written and approved. When you're answering a security questionnaire, building a proposal section, or replying to a buyer, ChatGPT works from your approved content.

Requires a paid AutoRFP.ai account.
payload.longDescription:
AutoRFP.ai 是以准确性为先的 AI 平台，用于 RFP、安全问卷和 DDQ。此插件将 ChatGPT 连接到你实时的 RFP、DDQ 或安全问卷项目，以及有来源依据的内容库。

询问当前 RFP 项目中有哪些未完成事项，列出仍待回答的问题，并在内容库中搜索准确答案，无需离开对话。

使用团队已经撰写并批准的内容起草。当你回答安全问卷、编写提案章节或回复买家时，ChatGPT 会依据已批准的内容开展工作。

需要付费 AutoRFP.ai 账号。

payload.name: Private PDF Tools
payload.description: 私密编辑 PDF 文件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Merge and compress PDFs, turn images into PDFs, rename output files, split PDFs, extract selected pages, and rotate PDF pages.

Files are processed locally in your browser. AILabTools does not download, store, or retain your file contents. Depending on the ChatGPT client, you can download the finished file or save it back to ChatGPT.

Use the guided workflow to combine files and reduce file size, or use focused tools for splitting, extracting, and rotating PDF pages.
payload.longDescription:
合并和压缩 PDF、将图片转为 PDF、重命名输出文件、拆分 PDF、提取指定页面并旋转 PDF 页面。

文件会在浏览器本地处理。AILabTools 不会下载、存储或保留你的文件内容。根据所用的 ChatGPT 客户端，你可以下载处理完成的文件，或将其保存回 ChatGPT。

使用引导式工作流合并文件并减小文件体积，也可以使用专用工具拆分、提取和旋转 PDF 页面。

payload.name: A Seat Awaits
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A Seat Awaits helps authorized users manage event seating through ChatGPT. Paid subscribers receive planner tools by tier, including event creation, guest search, table creation, guest assignment, guest-list import, capacity checks, and event health reviews. Authorized operators and approved partners can retrieve aggregate marketing, revenue, traffic, signup, subscription, pricing, and partner payout metrics when granted.
payload.longDescription: A Seat Awaits 帮助获授权用户通过 ChatGPT 管理活动座位。付费订阅者按订阅等级获得规划工具，包括创建活动、搜索宾客、创建桌位、安排宾客、导入宾客名单、检查容量和审查活动整体状况。获授权的运营人员和经批准的合作伙伴，可在获得相应许可后检索汇总的营销、收入、流量、注册、订阅、定价和合作伙伴付款指标。

payload.name: Genesys
payload.description: 跨 AI 应用的记忆系统
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Genesys gives your AI a causal memory graph — not a list of remembered facts, but a living network where every memory is a node, every relationship is a typed causal edge, and every retrieval can be explained. Ask why a memory surfaced and Genesys shows its relevance score, causal connectivity, and reactivation history. Trace how memories connect and follow full causal chains from decision to consequence.

Your memory graph is yours: it lives outside any single AI vendor, works identically with ChatGPT, Claude, and any MCP-compatible model, and travels with you when you switch. You control it directly — pin what matters permanently, inspect graph health at any time, and delete anything, anytime, with hard erasure.

Built on neuroscience-inspired scoring (relevance × causal connectivity × reactivation), Genesys forgets safely: only memories that are irrelevant, causally orphaned, and unpinned are ever pruned.
payload.longDescription:
Genesys 为你的 AI 提供因果记忆图谱——它不是一份记忆事实的清单，而是一个持续演进的网络，其中每条记忆都是一个节点，每种关系都是带类型的因果边，并且每次检索都可以解释。询问某条记忆为何出现，Genesys 会显示其相关性评分、因果关联和重新激活历史。追踪记忆之间的联系，并沿着从决策到结果的完整因果链进行探索。

你的记忆图谱由你掌控：它独立于任何单一 AI 服务商，可与 ChatGPT、Claude 及任何兼容 MCP 的模型以相同方式协同工作，并会在你切换服务时随你迁移。你可以直接管理它——永久固定重要内容，随时检查图谱健康状况，并可在任何时候彻底删除任何内容。

Genesys 基于受神经科学启发的评分方式（相关性 × 因果关联 × 重新激活）构建，能够安全遗忘：只有不相关、因果关系断裂且未固定的记忆才会被清除。

payload.name: FamilyWise HQ
payload.description: 膳食计划、清单和日常安排
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FamilyWise HQ is a family organizer and meal planner that helps you manage shared plans in ChatGPT. Plan weekly meals, save recipes and side dishes, manage grocery and shopping lists, and organize your FamilyWise calendar, reminders, chores and routines.

Get help with your next setup step, ask for a weekly family briefing, adjust dinner plans, or assign an everyday routine to a family member. Review the proposed changes and confirm before anything is saved to your authorized Home.

Connect your existing FamilyWise HQ account and shared Home. FamilyWise Plus or Premium is required. The connection does not access health information, medications or private family-member profiles, and it cannot change calendars outside FamilyWise.
payload.longDescription:
FamilyWise HQ 是一款家庭事务组织与膳食规划工具，帮助你在 ChatGPT 中管理共享计划。规划每周餐食、保存食谱和配菜、管理杂货与购物清单，并整理 FamilyWise 日历、提醒、家务和日常安排。

获取下一步设置帮助、询问每周家庭简报、调整晚餐计划，或为家庭成员分配日常任务。任何内容保存到已授权的 Home 之前，你都可以先查看并确认拟议更改。

连接你现有的 FamilyWise HQ 账户和共享 Home。需要 FamilyWise Plus 或 Premium。此连接不会访问健康信息、药物或家庭成员的私人个人资料，也无法更改 FamilyWise 之外的日历。

payload.name: eIgreja
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: eIgreja helps leaders and members use the dashboard: it explains workspaces (Worship, Schedules, Events, Library, and others), screens, tasks, and who can do what, based on the Training and Help manual. View-only—does not modify church data.
payload.longDescription: eIgreja 根据培训与帮助手册，为领导者和成员说明仪表板的工作区（礼拜、日程、活动、资料库等）、页面、任务以及各角色的操作权限。仅供查看，不会修改教会数据。

payload.name: Health Connect America Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Health Connect America Careers helps job seekers explore open roles at Health Connect America. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. 
Powered by Appcast.
payload.longDescription:
Health Connect America Careers 帮助求职者探索 Health Connect America 的空缺职位。按职位名称、地点或两者搜索，助手会显示相关机会，让你在申请前深入了解详情。
由 Appcast 提供支持。

payload.name: Jackpot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jackpot connects ChatGPT to your brand asset library so you can search assets, browse visual galleries, inspect collections and executions, prepare chat-safe previews, update metadata, run preview edits, and optionally attach assets to connected destinations you already authorized.
payload.longDescription: Jackpot 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的品牌素材库，让你搜索素材、浏览视觉图库、查看合集和执行项目、准备适合在聊天中查看的预览、更新元数据、运行预览编辑，并可选择将素材附加到你已授权连接的目标位置。

payload.name: Hydrosight
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hydrosight connects your soil sensors to ChatGPT, so you can check real-time and historical soil moisture, temperature and salinity data, review weather conditions and forecasts, and make better irrigation decisions using simple questions.
payload.longDescription: Hydrosight 将土壤传感器连接到 ChatGPT，让你通过简单提问查看实时和历史土壤湿度、温度及盐度数据，了解天气状况和预报，并据此做出更好的灌溉决策。

payload.name: AIOProductOS
payload.description: 围绕同一记录开展产品工作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AIOProductOS connects ChatGPT to a product workspace where revenue, customer feedback, product analytics, delivery work and code all hang off one shared customer record. Users read the board and the product brain, capture feedback as insights and link it to features, run revenue-weighted NPS, NRR, funnel and retention analysis, manage OKRs, sprints and releases, work the support inbox, and create or update tasks — all against their own authenticated workspace. Because money, behaviour and feedback sit on the same record, users can ask which accounts requested a feature and what they pay, then act on the answer without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: AIOProductOS 将 ChatGPT 连接到产品工作区，营收、客户反馈、产品分析、交付工作和代码都关联到同一份共享客户记录。用户可读取看板和产品知识中心，将反馈记录为洞察并关联到功能，进行营收加权的NPS、NRR、漏斗和留存分析，管理OKR、冲刺和发布，处理支持收件箱，以及创建或更新任务——所有操作都在用户自己已认证的工作区内进行。资金、行为和反馈位于同一记录上，因此用户可询问哪些客户要求某项功能、他们支付了多少钱，然后无需离开对话就能根据答案采取行动。

payload.name: Readplace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Readplace is a read-it-later app your assistant can work with directly to dave original sources of your searches. Save a link mid-conversation and it lands in the same queue you read from in the browser and on your phone, with the title, excerpt, and a clean reader view filled in.

Your assistant can read that queue back too: list what you've saved, filter to unread, pull an article's details, reader view, or AI summary to talk about it, surface related saves from your own queue, and mark things read or unread as you get to them.
payload.longDescription:
Readplace 是一款稍后阅读应用，你的助手可以直接使用它保存搜索结果的原始来源。在对话中途保存链接后，该链接会进入你在浏览器和手机上使用的同一队列，并自动填入标题、摘录和简洁的阅读视图。

助手也可以读取该队列：列出你保存的内容、筛选未读项目、提取文章详情、阅读视图或 AI 摘要供你讨论、从自己的队列中找出相关收藏，并在你读完后将项目标记为已读或未读。

payload.name: QRStuff
payload.description: 生成并跟踪 QR 码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate, customize, and analyze dynamic and static QR codes. Create custom-styled QR codes for URLs, vCards, Wi-Fi networks, and more, and track scan analytics instantly.
payload.longDescription: 生成、自定义并分析动态和静态 QR 码。为 URL、vCard、Wi-Fi 网络等创建自定义样式的 QR 码，并即时跟踪扫描分析数据。

payload.name: Clean Harbors Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clean Harbors Careers helps job seekers explore open roles at Clean Harbors. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. Powered by Appcast.
payload.longDescription: Clean Harbors Careers 帮助求职者探索 Clean Harbors 的开放职位。按职位名称、地点或两者搜索，助手会显示相关机会，让你在申请前深入了解详情。由 Appcast 提供支持。

payload.name: Arkon Vault
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Keep projects moving across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and other AI tools with one private continuity layer. Arkon Vault finds the right project context, runs a preflight before work starts, records decisions, and creates structured handoffs so every AI can continue from the same vision and next step. Use it to search shared project memory, prevent parallel forks, checkpoint progress, and leave a clear closeout for the next session. Workspaces are privately isolated, connections use scoped OAuth access, and Arkon Sync can optionally capture supported local sessions.
payload.longDescription: 通过一个私密的连续性层，让项目在ChatGPT、Codex、Claude和其他AI工具之间持续推进。Arkon Vault找到合适的项目上下文，在工作开始前执行预检查、记录决策，并创建结构化交接，让每个AI都能从相同的愿景和下一步继续。使用它搜索共享项目记忆、防止并行分叉、保存进度检查点，并为下一次会话留下清晰的收尾记录。工作空间私密隔离，连接使用限定范围的OAuth访问，Arkon Sync还可选择捕获受支持的本地会话。

payload.name: Centennial Arts Email
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A managed, read-only email connector that lists accounts and folders, searches messages, reads selected message text, analyzes bounded email activity, and reconstructs conversations. It cannot send, draft, reply, forward, move, delete, flag, mark mail read, or download attachments.
payload.longDescription: 这是一个托管式、只读的电子邮件连接器，可列出账户和文件夹、搜索邮件、读取选定邮件正文、分析限定范围内的邮件活动并还原对话。它不能发送、起草、回复、转发、移动或删除邮件，不能标记邮件或将邮件设为已读，也不能下载附件。

payload.name: Wazu
payload.description: 搜索并保存 Wazu 记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wazu connects ChatGPT to the user's authorized personal and cohort memory. It can inspect the active Wazu scope, list permitted cohorts, retrieve recent or topic-matched evidence, hydrate complete items and document passages, explore related evidence through Hive Map, retrieve bounded media references, and save user-authorized summaries, text, or media into an explicit cohort.
payload.longDescription: Wazu 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户获授权的个人及群组记忆。它可以检查当前启用的 Wazu 范围、列出获准访问的群组、检索近期或与主题匹配的证据、加载完整条目和文档段落、通过 Hive Map 探索相关证据、检索范围受限的媒体引用，并将用户授权的摘要、文本或媒体保存到指定群组。

payload.name: Ideaflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ideaflow helps users confirm their signed-in account, open their notes app URL, and search, filter, read, list hashtags, link, create, edit, organize, publish, delete, and restore personal notes and folders through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Ideaflow 帮助用户确认已登录账户、打开笔记应用网址，并通过 ChatGPT 搜索、筛选、阅读笔记，列出标签、建立链接，以及创建、编辑、整理、发布、删除和恢复个人笔记与文件夹。

payload.name: Success Academy Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Success Academy Careers helps job seekers explore open roles at Success Academy Charter Schools. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. Powered by Appcast.
payload.longDescription: Success Academy Careers 帮助求职者浏览 Success Academy Charter Schools 的开放职位。按职位名称、地点或两者一起搜索，助手会显示相关机会，并让你在申请前深入了解职位详情。由 Appcast 提供支持。

payload.name: Transcriptor
payload.description: 查看视频转录文本和元数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Transcriptor lets ChatGPT work with video the way it works with text. Paste a link from YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion or Reddit and ask for a summary, a quote with its timestamp, the chapter list, the publisher and view counts, or the still frame at a given timecode. Eight read-only tools cover the workflow: cleaned plain-text transcripts with cursor pagination for long videos, raw SRT/VTT subtitles, the list of available caption languages, extended metadata, chapter markers, single frames at any timecode, batch transcripts for selected playlist items, and YouTube search. Four of them render interactive widgets in the chat: a search carousel, a searchable timed transcript, a metadata card, and a frame viewer. The service retrieves only public captions, metadata, thumbnails and single still frames; it never returns or redistributes video or audio files.
payload.longDescription: Transcriptor 让 ChatGPT 像处理文本一样处理视频。粘贴 YouTube、Twitter/X、Instagram、TikTok、Twitch、Vimeo、Facebook、Bilibili、VK、Dailymotion 或 Reddit 链接，然后要求生成摘要、带时间戳的引述、章节列表、发布者和观看次数，或指定时间码的静帧。8 个只读工具覆盖整个流程：支持长视频游标分页的清理后纯文本转录、原始 SRT/VTT 字幕、可用字幕语言列表、扩展元数据、章节标记、任意时间码的单帧、所选播放列表项目的批量转录，以及 YouTube 搜索。其中 4 个工具会在聊天中生成交互式组件：搜索轮播、可搜索的定时转录文本、元数据卡片和画面查看器。该服务仅获取公开字幕、元数据、缩略图和单张静帧；绝不返回或重新分发视频或音频文件。

payload.name: Zentrik
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zentrik is the product operating system and second brain for product teams. In ChatGPT, search an authorized workspace for customer evidence, trace opportunities to the proof behind them, spot repeated problems, and capture new evidence for review.
payload.longDescription: Zentrik 是面向产品团队的产品运营系统和第二大脑。在 ChatGPT 中搜索获授权的工作区，追溯机会背后的客户证据、发现反复出现的问题，并收集新证据以供审核。

payload.name: Elodus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Elodus helps teams organize software-development workspaces, read and author structured documents, manage work orders and data models, explore research and grant sources, and maintain connected project artifacts through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Elodus 帮助团队整理软件开发工作区、阅读和撰写结构化文档、管理工作订单与数据模型、探索研究和资助来源，并通过 ChatGPT 维护相互关联的项目资料。

payload.name: Savantis Memory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Savantis Memory gives your assistants one memory that belongs to you. Recall preferences and decisions across conversations, add new memories with user approval, organize them into spaces, and manage confirmed references that take priority over inferred memories. Contradictions remain visible instead of being silently overwritten, and each item can be corrected, exported, or deleted.
payload.longDescription: Savantis Memory 为你的助手提供一份属于你的记忆。跨对话回忆偏好和决定，在获得用户批准后添加新记忆，将记忆整理到不同空间，并管理优先于推断记忆的已确认参考信息。矛盾内容会保持可见，不会被悄悄覆盖；每条内容都可以更正、导出或删除。

payload.name: DealKeep
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DealKeep is the tracker for people who buy lifetime software deals. Connect it and ask, in plain language, about the stack you already own: "What do I have for email marketing?", "Do I already own something like this before I buy it?", "Which refund windows are about to close?", or "Are any of my tools' founders going quiet?" Five read-only tools cover it — search your tools, check a purchase for duplicates, pull one license's full detail, list your deals, and surface founder-risk signals. The connector is strictly read-only: it can look across your library but can never buy, redeem, edit, or delete anything, and it only ever sees your own data. Connect with your existing DealKeep account (dealkeep.io).
payload.longDescription: DealKeep 面向终身软件优惠买家，提供只读工具来搜索已购工具、发现重复购买、查看许可证详情、列出优惠并提示创始人风险。不能购买、兑换、编辑或删除，只访问你的 DealKeep 数据。

payload.name: Task Tool
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Verify Task Tool availability or create, get, list, and update managed tasks and their private Markdown plans.
payload.longDescription: 验证 Task Tool 是否可用，或创建、获取、列出并更新受管理的任务及其私有 Markdown 计划。

payload.name: Whalesync
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Whalesync keeps data in sync between the tools your team already uses — Airtable, Webflow, HubSpot, Salesforce, Notion, Postgres, and more — with two-way sync that feels native in every app.

With this app connected, you can build and run syncs by describing them: create a sync between two apps, map tables and fields, validate the mapping, and turn the sync on. Once data is flowing, ask it to monitor things — check sync status, find out why a record isn’t syncing, review pending deletes, and retry failed work after you fix the cause.
payload.longDescription:
Whalesync 可在团队已使用的工具之间同步数据，包括 Airtable、Webflow、HubSpot、Salesforce、Notion、Postgres 等，并在每款应用中提供原生般的双向同步体验。

连接此应用后，你可以通过描述需求来创建并运行同步：在两款应用之间建立同步、映射表格和字段、验证映射并启用同步。数据开始流动后，还可以要求它监控同步情况——检查同步状态、查明某条记录为何未同步、查看待处理的删除操作，并在修复原因后重试失败任务。

payload.name: Klee
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Klee transcribes your meetings and makes them available to ChatGPT. Search and query your transcripts ("where did we discuss the budget?"), retrieve documents, check your remaining hours, organize projects with their vocabulary and participants, prepare sessions and schedule Teams meetings. Sensitive actions always ask for your confirmation. Requires a Klee account (5-hour free trial at klee-app.com). App and transcripts are French-first - built for French-speaking meetings.
payload.longDescription: Klee 会转录你的会议并提供给 ChatGPT。搜索和查询转录内容（“我们在哪里讨论过预算？”）、检索文档、查看剩余时长、使用项目词汇和参与者整理项目、准备会议并安排 Teams 会议。敏感操作始终会请求你确认。需要 Klee 账户（可在 klee-app.com 免费试用 5 小时）。应用和转录以法语为主，专为法语会议打造。

payload.name: CapMind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Capmind connects your personal recordings and meeting intelligence to ChatGPT.

Use Capmind to search your past recordings, retrieve transcripts and summaries, review key decisions, and find action items from conversations stored in your Capmind account.

Capmind only accesses data belonging to the authenticated user. The app is read-only and does not create, edit, delete, publish, or share recordings on the user’s behalf.
payload.longDescription:
Capmind 将你的个人录音和会议智能功能连接到 ChatGPT。

使用 Capmind 搜索过往录音、获取转录文本和摘要、查看关键决定，并查找保存在 Capmind 账户中的对话待办事项。

Capmind 仅访问经过身份验证的用户所属的数据。此应用为只读，不会代表用户创建、编辑、删除、发布或分享录音。

payload.name: UserTold
payload.description: 基于真实用户开展研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UserTold runs consented interviews inside a product and lets ChatGPT inspect source-linked Evidence, design and manage Studies, turn findings into reviewed Work, and explicitly hand ready Work to GitHub or Linear.
payload.longDescription: UserTold 可在产品内开展已征得同意的访谈，并让 ChatGPT 检查带有来源链接的 Evidence、设计和管理 Studies、将发现转化为经过审核的 Work，并明确将已准备好的 Work 交付到 GitHub 或 Linear。

payload.name: RealtyAds
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The RealtyAds MCP connection allows you fully manage all your RealtyAds properties. All functionality available in the RealtyAds portal is now available directly in ChatGPT. You can create and edit ads, save ads for later use, view performance and pull reports, and ask product and support questions.
payload.longDescription: RealtyAds MCP 连接可让你全面管理所有 RealtyAds 房产。RealtyAds 门户中的全部功能现在都能直接在 ChatGPT 中使用。你可以创建和编辑广告、保存广告以供日后使用、查看表现并获取报告，还可以咨询产品和支持问题。

payload.name: DeepL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DeepL brings high-accuracy translation into ChatGPT. Translate text across 100+ languages, and translate entire documents (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, HTML, plain text, subtitles, XLIFF) while preserving their original layout and formatting. Glossaries, style rules, and custom instructions from the user's DeepL account are applied to keep terminology and tone consistent, and DeepL Write rephrases or corrects text for grammar, typos, style, and tone. Connects to the user's existing DeepL account via OAuth.
payload.longDescription: DeepL 将高准确度翻译带入 ChatGPT。可在 100+ 种语言之间翻译文本，也可翻译完整文档（Word、PowerPoint、Excel、PDF、HTML、纯文本、字幕、XLIFF），同时保留原有版式和格式。系统会应用用户 DeepL 账户中的术语表、风格规则和自定义指令，以保持术语和语气一致；DeepL Write 还可改写或校正文稿的语法、错字、文风和语气。通过 OAuth 连接用户现有的 DeepL 账户。

payload.name: OpusClip
payload.description: 剪辑、编辑并排期发布视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OpusClip brings AI video editing into ChatGPT. Turn long videos into short clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, with AI-selected highlights, automatic reframing, and animated captions.
Start with a public or unlisted video link from a supported source, or use videos already uploaded to OpusClip. Edit through conversation: cut unwanted sections, remove filler words and pauses, and customize captions. Your edits are saved to your OpusClip workspace.
Export clips, draft social copy, and request publishing or scheduling to your connected social accounts. You choose the clips, destination accounts, and publishing times.
payload.longDescription:
OpusClip 将 AI 视频编辑带入 ChatGPT。把长视频转换成适用于 TikTok、Instagram Reels 和 YouTube Shorts 的短视频片段，并由 AI 挑选精彩片段、自动重新取景和添加动态字幕。
从受支持来源提供公开视频或未列出视频的链接，也可以使用已上传到 OpusClip 的视频。通过对话进行编辑：剪掉不需要的部分、删除填充词和停顿，并自定义字幕。编辑内容会保存到你的 OpusClip 工作区。
导出短片、起草社交媒体文案，并请求发布或排期到已连接的社交账户。由你选择视频片段、目标账户和发布时间。

payload.name: timr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: timr helps users inspect current activity and balances, review time and mileage records, start or stop timers, add or update entries, and manage multi-day leave through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: timr 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看当前活动和余额、检查工时与里程记录、启动或停止计时器、添加或更新记录，并管理跨多日的休假。

payload.name: NewsTune Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NewsTune Studio helps ChatGPT and Codex inspect existing series, produce private episodes, wait for completion, return direct episode links, compare authorized voices, open secure voice-selection or consented-cloning handoffs, publish approved public pages and RSS feeds, and prepare user-completed distribution to podcast platforms.
payload.longDescription: NewsTune Studio 帮助 ChatGPT 和 Codex 查看现有系列、制作私人单集、等待制作完成并返回单集直达链接、比较获准使用的语音、打开安全的语音选择或经同意的语音克隆交接流程、发布已批准的公开页面和 RSS Feed，并为用户自行完成的播客平台分发做好准备。

payload.name: Fixture and Finish
payload.description: 定制住宅的选材与采购
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fixture and Finish is a selections and procurement platform built for custom home builders, interior designers, and design-build firms. This plugin brings your project data into ChatGPT so you can ask questions in plain language from anywhere — the office, the job site, or your phone.
Ask ChatGPT to:

Look up any item on a project — fixture specs, finishes, model numbers, dimensions, and installation details
Check procurement status across projects: what’s been ordered, what’s shipped, what needs a decision
Search your selection library of products you’ve already vetted and used
Import a product from any vendor page into your library and attach it to an item
Create follow-up tasks and reminders on a project

Instead of digging through emails, spreadsheets, and spec sheets, ask: “What’s the fan in the Leesburg primary bedroom, and how does the remote work?” or “What’s still unordered for the kitchen at Wilson Lane?” and get an answer grounded in your actual project data.
Fixture and Finish keeps selections, specs, vendors, and purchase status structured in one place, so client-facing docs, field schedules, and answers like these work out of the box. Requires a Fixture and Finish account; trials are free with no credit card required.
payload.longDescription:
Fixture and Finish 是一个选材和采购平台，面向定制住宅建筑商、室内设计师和设计施工公司。此插件会将项目数据接入 ChatGPT，让你无论在办公室、施工现场还是手机上，都能用自然语言提问。
向 ChatGPT 提出请求：

查找项目中的任意物品——设备规格、饰面、型号、尺寸和安装详情
查看各项目的采购状态：哪些已下单、已发货，哪些仍待决策
搜索你已审核并使用过的产品选材库
从任意供应商页面导入产品到资料库，并将其关联到某个物品
为项目创建后续任务和提醒

无需翻找电子邮件、电子表格和规格表，只需询问：“Leesburg 主卧室的风扇是什么型号，遥控器怎么用？”或“Wilson Lane 厨房还有哪些东西没下单？”即可获得基于实际项目数据的回答。
Fixture and Finish 会将选材、规格、供应商和采购状态结构化地整理在一处，因此客户文档、现场进度表及类似问题的答复都可以开箱即用。需要 Fixture and Finish 账户；试用免费，无需信用卡。

payload.name: Pocket Bartender
payload.description: Pocket Bartender 鸡尾酒配方与调酒应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pocket Bartender is a reference library of 700+ drink recipes — cocktails, shots, punches, coffees, smoothies and 86 non-alcoholic options, including 113 official IBA classics.

Ask for any drink by name and get the full recipe: every ingredient with its measure, numbered method steps, preparation time, ABV, calories and food pairings.

Or list what you have at home — “gin, Campari, sweet vermouth, some limes” — and it works out which drinks you can make right now, and which ones you are a single ingredient away from, so your next purchase is the useful one.

Everything is available in 25 languages, with measures written the way a bartender would say them. Every recipe links back to the Pocket Bartender app for iOS and Android.
payload.longDescription:
Pocket Bartender 是一个包含 700+ 种饮品配方的参考库，涵盖鸡尾酒、烈酒小杯、宾治、咖啡、冰沙和 86 款无酒精饮品，其中包括 113 款 IBA 官方经典配方。

按名称询问任意饮品，即可获取完整配方：每种配料及其用量、编号步骤、准备时间、酒精度、卡路里和搭配食物。

或者列出家里的食材——“金酒、Campari、甜味美思，还有一些青柠”——它会计算您现在可以调制哪些饮品，以及还差一种配料就能制作哪些饮品，让您的下一次采购买得有用。

所有内容提供 25 种语言，计量方式采用调酒师习惯的表达。每个配方都链接回适用于 iOS 和 Android 的 Pocket Bartender 应用。

payload.name: Continuity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Keep character details, world rules, and story events consistent across ChatGPT conversations. Save approved facts and scene summaries, retrieve them when continuing a story in a new chat, and check drafts against saved canon for contradictions. Save provisional checkpoints for unfinished scenes, unresolved questions, and next steps. Continuity receives only content sent through its tools with your permission. It does not automatically back up entire chats, recover unsaved details, or guarantee error-free writing. Requires an existing Continuity account with Pro or active trial access.
payload.longDescription: 在不同 ChatGPT 对话中保持角色细节、世界规则和故事事件一致。保存已确认的事实与场景摘要，在新聊天续写故事时检索，并检查草稿是否与已保存的正史设定矛盾。还可为未完成场景、悬而未决的问题和后续步骤保存临时检查点。Continuity 只接收你通过其工具并经你许可发送的内容。它不会自动备份完整聊天、找回未保存的细节，也不保证写作绝无错误。需要已有 Continuity 账户，且具备 Pro 方案或有效的试用权限。

payload.name: OSuite.ai
payload.description: 审核有风险的 AI 操作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OSuite.ai helps teams review important AI actions before they happen. It can route risky work into approval, check whether an action is cleared to continue, summarize runtime exposure, and keep an audit-ready record of what was reviewed, approved, and completed.
payload.longDescription: OSuite.ai 帮助团队在重要 AI 操作发生前进行审核。它可以将高风险工作转入审批流程、检查操作是否获准继续、汇总运行时风险，并保留可供审计的记录，记录哪些事项经过审核、批准和完成。

payload.name: Fontis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: O Fontis pesquisa uma base curada de instrumentos jurídicos brasileiros e retorna trechos literais com citação, fonte e status de vigência. A cobertura inclui o Código Civil, o Código de Processo Civil, a CLT, o Código Penal, o Código de Defesa do Consumidor, o Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente, a LGPD, a Lei de Alimentos, a Lei de Registros Públicos, a Lei da União Estável e a Lei da Mulher Casada; as súmulas do STF e do STJ e as súmulas vinculantes; os enunciados das Jornadas de Direito Civil do CJF; o Protocolo do CNJ para Julgamento com Perspectiva de Gênero; e a Tabela de Honorários da OAB/SP. O plugin é voltado a profissionais do Direito que precisam localizar fundamentação rastreável para conferência. Ele não prevê resultados processuais, não substitui aconselhamento jurídico profissional e não cobre direito estrangeiro.
payload.longDescription: Fontis 会搜索经筛选的巴西法律文书数据库，并返回附有引文、来源和现行状态的原文摘录。收录内容包括《民法典》《民事诉讼法》《劳动法典》《刑法典》《消费者保护法》《儿童和青少年法》《通用数据保护法》（LGPD）、《食品法》《公共登记法》《稳定婚姻法》和《已婚妇女法》；STF 和 STJ 判例摘要及具有约束力的判例摘要；CJF 民法会议决议；CNJ《性别视角审判议定书》；以及 OAB/SP 律师费标准表。此插件面向需要查找可追溯法律依据以供核验的法律专业人士。它不会预测诉讼结果，不能替代专业法律建议，也不涵盖外国法。

payload.name: Meetly
payload.description: 把会议转化为实用成果
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Meetly by Edge First AI lets users find meetings they explicitly sync and retrieve speaker-tagged evidence. Packaged skills then help the host summarize, research, map, teach, plan, and create product documents with its native capabilities.
payload.longDescription: Edge First AI 出品的 Meetly 帮助用户查找自己明确同步的会议，并调取带有发言者标签的证据。随后可使用配套技能，借助其原生功能进行总结、研究、梳理、教学、规划并创建产品文档。

payload.name: Synaply
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to your organization's permission-aware knowledge. Synaply searches across connected email, chat, files, code, calendars, CRM records, insights, and people; reads verified source documents; traces decisions and outcomes; and lets users share durable insights for org-wide learning. Results are limited to the authenticated user's workspace permissions.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到组织内受权限控制的知识库。Synaply 会搜索已连接的电子邮件、聊天、文件、代码、日历、CRM 记录、洞察和人员信息；读取经过验证的源文档；追溯决策及结果；并让用户分享可长期保留的洞察，促进全组织学习。搜索结果仅限于经过身份验证的用户在工作区中拥有的权限范围。

payload.name: bryny
payload.description: 跟踪您的 bryny 运营
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
bryny MCP Server connects your AI assistant to your own operational data on the bryny fulfilment and logistics platform in Tunisia. Merchants who store their physical goods in bryny warehouses can ask, in plain language, how their orders are progressing, which products are running out of stock, where a parcel is, and how their fulfilment activity is doing — without opening a dashboard.

Access is strictly scoped: you only ever see the data of the account you signed in with. A merchant sees their own orders, products, stock and deliveries; a customer sees their own orders and returns; an administrator sees platform-wide operations.

Key capabilities:
• Order operations: list, search, filter and analyse your own orders and their delivery statuses
• Inventory and stock: real-time stock levels, low-stock and out-of-stock alerts, stock movements
• Shop operations: your shop profile, product records and fulfilment activity summaries
• Logistics: parcel tracking, delivery progress and delivery failure analysis
• Support: your own support tickets and customer returns
• Platform health: service status and audit trail (administrators only)

No purchase, cart, checkout or payment exists in this app. Every transaction happens outside ChatGPT: end customers pay the delivery driver in cash when the parcel arrives, and bryny never collects card or bank details.
payload.longDescription:
bryny MCP Server 将您的 AI 助手连接到突尼斯 bryny 履约与物流平台上的运营数据。将实物存放在 bryny 仓库的商家可以用自然语言询问订单进度、哪些产品即将缺货、包裹在哪里以及履约情况，无需打开仪表板。

访问权限严格限定：您只能看到所登录账户的数据。商家看到自己的订单、产品、库存和配送；客户看到自己的订单和退货；管理员看到平台级运营数据。

主要功能：
• 订单运营：列出、搜索、筛选并分析您自己的订单及配送状态
• 库存：实时库存、低库存和缺货提醒、库存变动
• 店铺运营：店铺资料、产品记录和履约活动摘要
• 物流：包裹跟踪、配送进度和配送失败分析
• 支持：您自己的支持工单和客户退货
• 平台健康：服务状态和审计轨迹（仅管理员）

此应用不存在购买、购物车、结账或付款功能。所有交易都在 ChatGPT 外完成：终端客户在包裹到达时向配送员现金付款，bryny 从不收集银行卡或银行信息。

payload.name: Letsfind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Letsfind creates group polls from a description in the chat. Say which dates you want to propose, or which options people should choose between, and you get back a link to share.

There are two kinds of polls. A date poll proposes several days or time slots and asks everyone what works for them, which is the usual way to settle on a meeting, a dinner or a trip. An options poll asks a plain question with answers you define, for picking a restaurant, a name or a plan.

Every poll comes back with two links. The voting link is the one you send to the group; people open it in a browser and answer without creating an account or installing anything. The admin link is yours alone and the only way to edit the poll later, so it is worth keeping.

Once answers come in, you can ask here how the poll is doing instead of opening it yourself. You get the count for each option and the names of the people who picked it.
payload.longDescription:
Letsfind 可以根据聊天中的描述创建群组投票。说明你想提出哪些日期，或让大家在什么选项中选择，即可获得可分享的链接。

投票分为两种。日期投票会列出多个日期或时间段，询问大家哪些时间合适，通常用于确定会议、聚餐或旅行安排。选项投票则提出一个简单问题，并使用你定义的答案供大家选择，例如餐厅、名字或计划。

每个投票都会生成两个链接。投票链接用于发送给群组；大家在浏览器中打开即可作答，无需创建账户或安装任何东西。管理链接仅属于你，是之后编辑投票的唯一方式，建议妥善保存。

收到回答后，你可以直接在这里询问投票进展，无需自行打开链接。你会看到每个选项的票数以及选择该选项的参与者姓名。

payload.name: FORTVISION
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FORTVISION brings marketing activity into one workspace. Plan and manage campaigns, track leads and conversations, coordinate outreach and automations, and keep key marketing work organized across channels.
payload.longDescription: FORTVISION 将营销活动集中到一个工作区，可规划和管理活动、跟踪潜客与对话、协调外联和自动化并整理跨渠道工作。

payload.name: Jicoo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jicoo helps authorized team members inspect bookings, schedules, event types, routing forms, host assignment rules, organization users, meeting artifacts, and webhook endpoint settings through ChatGPT. It also supports creating or updating booking, schedule, event type, routing form, host assignment, and webhook configuration records when the user explicitly asks to make those changes.
payload.longDescription: 经授权的团队成员可以通过 ChatGPT 查看预订、日程、活动类型、路由表单、主持人分配规则、组织用户、会议资料和 webhook 端点设置。当用户明确要求进行更改时，也支持创建或更新预订、日程、活动类型、路由表单、主持人分配和 webhook 配置记录。

payload.name: Axis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Axis helps people track and manage finances, relationships, knowledge, habits, and focus. Its tools read private account data and create, update, or delete records only after OAuth consent.
payload.longDescription: Axis 帮助人们跟踪和管理财务、人际关系、知识、习惯和专注状态。其工具仅在获得 OAuth 同意后，才读取私人账户数据以及创建、更新或删除记录。

payload.name: Jessie Script Director
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A public-submission package for the Jessie Approved Script Director workflow. It guides one creative decision at a time, protects product facts and claims, reviews scripts, and plans Simplified Chinese JiMeng 出镜 prompts while preserving English spoken dialogue
payload.longDescription: 这是 Jessie Approved Script Director 工作流的公开提交软件包。它一次引导你做出一个创意决策，保护产品事实和宣传主张，审阅脚本，并规划简体中文即梦出镜提示词，同时保留英文口播台词。

payload.name: Kumbukum
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kumbukum gives ChatGPT access to a user's authenticated private memory workspace. Users can search and retrieve notes, memories, and project metadata, then create new private notes and memories when requested.
payload.longDescription: Kumbukum 可让 ChatGPT 访问用户经过身份验证的私密记忆工作区。用户可以搜索和检索笔记、记忆及项目元数据，并可按要求创建新的私密笔记和记忆。

payload.name: Skylar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Skylar helps authorized production teams find people, models, designers, shows, and events; inspect readiness, ticketing, admission, and documents; and make governed internal changes with previews, receipts, and undo.
payload.longDescription: Skylar 可帮助获授权的制作团队查找人员、模特、设计师、节目和活动；检查准备情况、票务、入场和文档；并通过预览、操作凭据和撤销功能，执行受管控的内部更改。

payload.name: CalendarBridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CalendarBridge is the market leader in calendar syncing and unified scheduling with over 100,000+ users. CalendarBridge keeps all of your calendars’ availability synced in real time and shows them in one unified calendar. With CalendarBridge you always know your availability is up to date across all of your calendars.

Connect Google, Outlook, Apple, and more so you can see every event together and make edits that update instantly across all of your accounts and devices. No more switching between apps, missing updates, or worrying about double bookings. 

Whether you’re tracking work meetings, family plans, school events, or personal appointments, CalendarBridge keeps everything accurate, connected and easy to manage. 
Our patented privacy technology ensures every update is accurate, private, and automatic.

With CalendarBridge, you can:
- Sync availability across multiple calendars in real-time 
- View and edit all connected calendars from a single Unified Calendar
- Share availability with scheduling links, or a booking page

Try CalendarBridge today and experience the easiest way to manage all your calendars in one place. The calendar sync app you never knew you needed, and the one you’ll wonder how you lived without.
payload.longDescription:
CalendarBridge 是日历同步和统一排程领域的市场领导者，拥有超过 100,000+ 名用户。它实时同步所有日历的空闲状态，并在一个统一日历中显示。借助 CalendarBridge，您始终知道各个日历上的最新可用时间。

连接 Google、Outlook、Apple 等账户，即可一起查看所有事件；编辑后会立即同步到所有账户和设备。无需再切换应用、错过更新或担心重复预订。无论是工作会议、家庭计划、学校活动还是个人预约，CalendarBridge

都能让一切准确、连接且易于管理。我们的专利隐私技术确保每次更新准确、私密且自动。
使用 CalendarBridge，您可以：

- 实时同步多个日历的可用时间
- 在一个统一日历中查看和编辑所有已连接日历
- 通过排程链接或预订页面分享可用时间

立即试用
 CalendarBridge，体验在一个地方管理所有日历的简单方式。这是一款您不知道自己需要、却会想知道过去如何生活的日历同步应用。

payload.name: Tako
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tako helps users find current data and metrics from proprietary datasets and the live web as citation-backed charts, retrieve the underlying result content, check available data coverage, and create shareable public chart links from user-provided structured data.
payload.longDescription: Tako 帮助用户从专有数据集和实时网络中查找当前数据与指标，并生成附带引文的图表；获取底层结果内容、检查可用数据覆盖范围，并根据用户提供的结构化数据创建可分享的公开图表链接。

payload.name: Convy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Convy helps households manage shared shopping lists and tasks directly from ChatGPT. Users can inspect household context, view shopping and task lists, open compact visual panels on request, add multiple shopping items, create tasks, and mark existing items or tasks as completed or pending. All write actions are limited to the user's private Convy household data and require confirmation.
payload.longDescription: Convy 帮助家庭成员直接通过 ChatGPT 管理共享购物清单和任务。用户可以查看家庭上下文、购物清单和任务清单，按需打开紧凑型可视面板，添加多件购物物品、创建任务，并将现有物品或任务标记为已完成或待办。所有写入操作仅限于用户自己的私有 Convy 家庭数据，并且需要确认。

payload.name: Esment
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Esment gives ChatGPT persistent, inspectable memory for facts, preferences, decisions, and project context. It can recall relevant context, save durable information, update or forget memories, and read organized pages (created locally, not yet available in the cloud) and memory blocks belonging to the authenticated user.
payload.longDescription: Esment 为 ChatGPT 提供可检查的持久记忆，用于保存事实、偏好、决策和项目背景。它可以回忆相关上下文、保存长期有用的信息、更新或遗忘记忆，并读取属于已认证用户的整理页面（在本地创建，尚未提供云端版本）和记忆区块。

payload.name: Reflect
payload.summaryOriginal: Get answers from your HR data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reflect turns your HR and workforce data into answers, right inside ChatGPT. Ask in plain language and Reflect queries your people analytics directly: headcount, turnover, recruitment, compensation and more, with no export or spreadsheet. It also surfaces the figures behind your legal and compliance reports (BDESE, Egapro index, EU pay transparency). It explores the data catalog you're allowed to see, runs structured analytics queries, and handles advanced SQL when needed. Read-only and secure by design: every request respects your existing Reflect permissions.
payload.longDescription: Reflect 将人力资源和员工数据转化为答案，直接在 ChatGPT 中呈现。用日常语言提问，Reflect 就会直接查询你的人力分析数据：员工人数、离职率、招聘、薪酬等，无需导出或使用电子表格。它还会呈现法律和合规报告中的数据（BDESE、Egapro index、EU pay transparency）。它会探索你获准查看的数据目录、运行结构化分析查询，并在需要时处理高级 SQL。按只读和安全原则设计：每个请求都会遵守你现有的 Reflect 权限。

payload.name: Joinways
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage inquiries, build quotes, check space availability, and generate banquet event orders (BEOs) for event venues directly from ChatGPT. Qualify a new lead, draft a quote for a wedding or corporate event, update a booking's status, send a follow-up email, or pull analytics on confirmed revenue — without leaving the conversation. Joinways helps event venue teams run everything from first inquiry to confirmed booking.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中管理活动场地的咨询、制作报价、检查场地可用情况并生成宴会活动订单 (BEO)。你可以筛选新线索、为婚礼或企业活动起草报价、更新预订状态、发送后续邮件，或查看已确认收入的分析数据，无需离开对话。Joinways 帮助活动场地团队处理从首次咨询到确认预订的整个流程。

payload.name: Evernote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Evernote MCP server connects your Evernote account to your AI tools, so they can work from the notes, documents, and files you've already collected. Search across years of captured material, edit and organize what's there, and file new work straight back into your notebooks.

Key features:
• Search by keyword or by meaning - Use Evernote's search grammar to filter by notebook, tag, and date, or search semantically to surface notes by what they're about, even when you can't remember the words you used.
• Find what you never typed - Search reaches text inside scanned documents, photos, and images, and inside transcribed audio and video — so handwritten pages, whiteboard shots, receipts, and recorded meetings are all searchable alongside your written notes. Attached files can be downloaded and new ones uploaded.
• Read, write, and edit real notes - Fetch a note's full content, tags, and attachments; create new notes in the right notebook; update titles and bodies; and restore anything that ends up in the trash.
• Keep your account organized - Move notes between notebooks, add and remove tags, rename and re-parent tags, and create notebooks and Spaces as your work grows.
• Manage tasks inside your notes - Create tasks, update status and due dates, and find the ones you own or have been assigned, filtered by priority.
Everything happens inside your own account, under your existing permissions.
payload.longDescription:
Evernote MCP 服务器将你的 Evernote 账户连接到 AI 工具，让它们可以利用你已收集的笔记、文档和文件。搜索多年积累的资料、编辑和整理现有内容，并将新成果直接存入笔记本。

主要功能：
• 按关键词或含义搜索——使用 Evernote 搜索语法按笔记本、标签和日期筛选，也可进行语义搜索；即使记不起用过哪些词，也能按内容主题找到笔记。
• 搜索你从未打过的文字——搜索范围包括扫描文档、照片和图像中的文字，以及音视频转录内容，因此手写页面、白板照片、收据和录制的会议都能与文字笔记一并搜索。附件可下载，也可上传新附件。
• 读取、撰写和编辑真实笔记——获取笔记全文、标签和附件；在合适的笔记本中新建笔记；更新标题和正文；并恢复误入废纸篓的内容。
• 整理账户——在笔记本间移动笔记、添加或移除标签、重命名标签并调整标签层级，还可随工作发展创建笔记本和 Spaces。
• 管理笔记中的任务——创建任务、更新状态和截止日期，并按优先级查找自己拥有或被分配的任务。
所有操作都在你自己的账户中进行，并遵循你现有的权限。

payload.name: TEAM 30 — AI Company OS
payload.description: 通过 31 个 AI 角色规划工作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TEAM 30 routes a goal to the right specialist role, turns projects into scope-locked plans, and identifies actions that need explicit approval. The first public version is read-only: it does not send messages, spend money, delete data, publish content, or connect private accounts.
payload.longDescription: TEAM 30 会将目标分配给合适的专业角色，把项目转化为范围明确的计划，并识别需要明确批准的操作。首个公开版本为只读：不会发送消息、花费资金、删除数据、发布内容或连接私人账户。

payload.name: SuperPrompter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SuperPrompter permite buscar, leer, guardar y actualizar prompts y guiones privados desde ChatGPT, con favoritos y carpetas de un nivel para cuentas Studio.
payload.longDescription: SuperPrompter 允许用户直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索、阅读、保存和更新私人提示词与脚本；Studio 账户还支持收藏和一级文件夹。

payload.name: NoClick
payload.description: 构建并运行 AI 工作流
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, test, and deploy automated workflows. NoClick makes automation accessible — connect your favorite tools, add logic and AI steps, and let your workflows save your time.
payload.longDescription: 构建、测试并部署自动化工作流。NoClick 让自动化易于使用：连接你喜欢的工具，添加逻辑和 AI 步骤，让工作流帮你节省时间。

payload.name: Acceptance Criteria Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Extracts explicitly written acceptance criteria from requirements, user stories, specifications, and testing notes. It returns structured results without generating missing criteria, evaluating requirements, or performing external actions.
payload.longDescription: 从需求、用户故事、规格说明和测试笔记中提取明确写出的验收标准。它返回结构化结果，不生成缺失标准，不评估需求，也不执行外部操作。

payload.name: Support Ticket Validator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Support Ticket Validator checks whether support ticket data contains the required fields before human processing or handoff. It returns a structured completeness result with checked fields, present fields, missing fields, and validation errors, helping support teams identify incomplete ticket information without modifying external systems.
payload.longDescription: Support Ticket Validator 会在人工作业或交接前，检查支持工单数据是否包含所需的必填字段。它返回结构化的完整性检查结果，包括已检查字段、已提供字段、缺失字段及验证错误，帮助支持团队识别不完整的工单信息，同时不修改外部系统。

payload.name: Vertical Bar Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vertical Bar Agent helps authorized teams inspect CrossCheck snapshots and process-mining data, analyze dependencies and telemetry, build grounded Briefings, manage test suites and release packages, and run governed NetSuite workflows through ChatGPT. It also helps author and publish Stress Test contracts, open their CrossCheck page to start a Run, and inspect Run progress and results. Agent-started Stress Test runs are available only in active sandbox or release-preview environments.
payload.longDescription: Vertical Bar Agent 帮助获授权的团队检查 CrossCheck 快照和流程挖掘数据、分析依赖关系与遥测数据、创建有依据的 Briefing、管理测试套件和发布包，并通过 ChatGPT 运行受治理的 NetSuite 工作流。它还可协助编写和发布 Stress Test 合约、打开对应的 CrossCheck 页面以启动一次 Run，并检查 Run 的进度和结果。只有在活动的沙盒或发布预览环境中，智能体才能启动 Stress Test 运行。

payload.name: Textxt
payload.description: 搜索你的 Textxt 聊天
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Textxt lets users connect their Textxt account to ChatGPT so they can search, summarize, and retrieve their own readable Textxt chats in conversation. The connector is read-only: it can list recent chats, search messages, fetch context for a search result, and read recent messages from a selected chat/topic. It does not send, edit, delete, or publish messages.
payload.longDescription: Textxt 让用户可以将自己的 Textxt 账户连接到 ChatGPT，从而在对话中搜索、总结和检索自己可阅读的 Textxt 聊天。此连接器为只读：它可以列出近期聊天、搜索消息、获取搜索结果的上下文，以及读取选定聊天/主题中的近期消息。它不会发送、编辑、删除或发布消息。

payload.name: Giraffe
payload.description: 让 AI 项目保持清晰
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Giraffe keeps your AI projects clear and current across ChatGPT and other compatible AI assistants. Save and retrieve project context, decisions, facts, notes, open questions, and documents from whichever AI tool you are using.

When plans change, Giraffe helps preserve the latest agreed state, what changed, and which earlier information was replaced—so you can continue working without searching through old chats or rebuilding context.

Use Giraffe to organize Spaces and Projects, search your knowledge, and create or update Documents directly from your AI assistant. Giraffe is free to use.
payload.longDescription:
Giraffe 可在 ChatGPT 及其他兼容的 AI 助手中，帮助你保持 AI 项目清晰且信息最新。无论你使用哪种 AI 工具，都可以保存和检索项目上下文、决策、事实、笔记、待解决问题和文档。

计划发生变化时，Giraffe 会帮助保留最新达成的一致状态、记录变更内容以及标记被替代的旧信息，让你无需翻找旧聊天或重建上下文即可继续工作。

通过 AI 助手使用 Giraffe 整理 Spaces 和 Projects、搜索知识，并直接创建或更新文档。Giraffe 可免费使用。

payload.name: B2 Portal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: B2 Portal turns customer emails, notes, transcripts, and attachments into review-ready CoreBridge V2 RFQs. Search authorized customers and QuickProducts, resolve draft decisions, apply explicit custom-line pricing, and push the exact current RFQ to CoreBridge only after presenting the final summary and receiving explicit operator approval. After a successful push, open the returned CoreBridge estimate and exact B2 Portal review page.
payload.longDescription: B2 Portal将客户邮件、笔记、转写稿和附件转为可供审核的CoreBridge V2询价单（RFQ）。搜索获授权的客户和QuickProducts、解决草稿中的待定事项、应用明确指定的自定义行项目定价，并且仅在展示最终摘要、获得操作人员明确批准后，才将当前确切的RFQ推送到CoreBridge。成功推送后，打开返回的CoreBridge估价单和对应的B2 Portal审核页面。

payload.name: Jamie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your meetings into ChatGPT. Ask about your work, draw on conversation context, and get work done.
payload.longDescription: 将你的会议带入 ChatGPT。询问工作相关问题，利用对话上下文，高效完成工作。

payload.name: Signeasy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Signeasy helps users review account activity, find documents and contracts, inspect signature status, send reminders, and prepare or send signature requests through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Signeasy 可帮助用户查看账户活动、查找文档和合同、查看签署状态、发送提醒，并通过 ChatGPT 准备或发送签署请求。

payload.name: Sonjapgo
payload.description: 借助 AI 延续项目
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sonjapgo connects ChatGPT to your projects, tasks, shared working documents, work reports, and private thought branches. Users can find and continue current work, create projects and tasks, record and complete work, and safely preview, apply, inspect, or restore line-level document changes through authenticated workflows. Sonjapgo keeps project context connected so ChatGPT can work from the latest project, task, document, and report information.
payload.longDescription: Sonjapgo 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的项目、任务、共享工作文档、工作报告和私人思路分支。用户可以查找并继续当前工作、创建项目和任务、记录并完成工作，还可以通过经过身份验证的工作流安全地预览、应用、检查或还原文档中逐行的更改。Sonjapgo 会持续关联项目上下文，让 ChatGPT 能依据最新的项目、任务、文档和报告信息开展工作。

payload.name: StewAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StewAI helps people discover approved AI workflows, preview their required inputs, estimate credits, run selected workflows, and retrieve declared final results without managing an API key.
payload.longDescription: StewAI 帮助用户发现获准使用的 AI 工作流、预览所需输入、估算额度、运行选定的工作流，并获取工作流声明的最终结果，无需管理 API 密钥。

payload.name: Cleverfy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cleverfy lleva el control horario a ChatGPT: ficha entrada y salida, consulta tu estado actual, revisa tus horas, solicita ausencias y corrige olvidos hablando de forma natural. Para equipos, ayuda a supervisar presencia, aprobaciones y registros con acciones guiadas, permisos por rol y una experiencia clara para mantener la jornada laboral al día.
payload.longDescription: Cleverfy 将工时管理带入 ChatGPT：用自然语言记录上下班打卡、查询当前状态、查看工时、申请休假并补正遗漏。对于团队，它通过引导式操作和角色权限，帮助监督出勤、审批和记录，并提供清晰易用的体验，让工作时间记录保持最新。

payload.name: Word Counter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Accurate word and character counts for drafts, essays, and snippets — using the same rules as ibm.io/wordcount. Returns words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time. Includes an in-chat widget for quick visual summary. Text is processed in memory and not stored. For private editing with word goals, link to the full offline browser app.
payload.longDescription: 按照与 ibm.io/wordcount 相同的规则，准确统计草稿、文章和片段的字数与字符数。可返回单词、字符、句子、段落和阅读时间，并提供聊天内小组件，快速直观地查看摘要。文本仅在内存中处理，不会保存。如需带字数目标的私密编辑，可链接到完整的离线浏览器应用。

payload.name: iManage Work
payload.description: 受治理的知识，随时供 AI 使用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Securely connect governed iManage content to ChatGPT. Search, read, and organize documents, inspect workspaces and folders, and upload or update content - all permission-bound and auditable. AI accesses your documents where they live in iManage, without requiring bulk exports or replication, as your AI strategy evolves.
payload.longDescription: 将受治理的 iManage 内容安全连接到 ChatGPT。搜索、阅读和整理文档，检查工作区和文件夹，并上传或更新内容——所有操作都受权限控制且可审计。随着 AI 策略不断演进，AI 可直接访问存放在 iManage 中的文档，无需批量导出或复制数据。

payload.name: Notit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Notit to ChatGPT to review your courses, lectures, Notes, transcripts, summaries, keywords, exam points, and Quick Reviews. Search your study materials and ask questions grounded in content already stored in your Notit account.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Notit 与 ChatGPT，查看课程、讲座、笔记、转录、摘要、关键词、考试要点和 Quick Reviews。搜索学习材料，并根据 Notit 账户中已存储的内容提问。

payload.name: Jaggle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Jaggle to search, review, organize, and safely update permission-filtered workspace work.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Jaggle，以搜索、审阅、整理并安全更新经过权限筛选的工作区内容。

payload.name: Ambiguous Workspace
payload.description: 人类与 AI 协作的工作区
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ambiguous is the workspace for human-AI collaboration. 17 productivity apps rebuilt from scratch to make work flow across Docs, Mail, Chat, Sheets, CRM, Calendar, and more. Each AI coworker has its own identity and works in the same apps and on the same data like the rest of the team. You can send it an email, message it in chat, assign it a task, or @mention it in a comment. Teams of up to five can use all 17 apps for free, and agents can get started through CLI or MCP in under a minute.
payload.longDescription: Ambiguous 是人类与 AI 协作的工作区。17 款生产力应用从零重新打造，让工作在 Docs、Mail、Chat、Sheets、CRM、Calendar 等应用间顺畅流转。每位 AI 同事都有自己的身份，像团队其他成员一样在相同应用中使用相同数据工作。你可以给它发邮件、在聊天中发消息、分配任务，或在评论中 @提及它。最多五人的团队可免费使用全部 17 款应用，智能体可通过 CLI 或 MCP 在不到一分钟内开始使用。

payload.name: Frasma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Frasma helps authorized teams review project work, search linked project knowledge, and create, update, or move private Kanban tasks from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Frasma 帮助获授权的团队通过 ChatGPT 审查项目工作、搜索关联的项目知识，并创建、更新或移动私有看板任务。
